Yeah...!!
I'm so glad I told you... so glad...!!

Huh...? But why?
What's the matter, Trainer? It tasted totally goo—

Yep!! It's been the climax of my
'Full-Power Day-Off Fun Schedule' foreeeever!!
Ah, right, right...
Even back then, it was already reeeaaally, insanely good, you know!?

...! T-Taste?
...What are you talking about? The recipe and ingredients are the same as before.
—MANAGEEEERRRRRR!!

But to make this the absolute best of the best...!
Let's wait in line together, Trainer!!

WAAAAAAHHHH!!
Manager!! Congraaaats, Manageeeerrr...!!
Yaaay!!

Mega-Extra Cream, Big-Glacé Chunks, Drenching-Sauce, a Pinch of Chips!
—Two of those, pleeeeaaase!!

I'm so haaaappyyyy~!!
Good for youuu, Manageeeerrr...!!

Whoa... huh? Wait.
Ticket-chan, you came?

Trainer!
Let's come eat crepes here again, okay?!

My stomach felt like it was gonna burst, so I ran around for a bit,
and by the time I got back, you were packing up, but—

...You know, I remember when I first ate
your crepe at that food stand in the tiny park!
As for that flavor—

...Yeah. You're right, Ticket-chan.
I... I don't want to forget that either.
!! With... all his might...!?
Huh...? W-Who are you...?

...Using busyness as an excuse, before I knew it, I was cutting corners.
Neglecting each and every step, not even looking at the customers' faces anymore.

I see... That makes no sense! No sense at all...!
Thinking 'it was just totally good' like that...!!

............
...Could you wait for me?

—Ah, though back then it was just a tiny
food stand that popped up at parks and stuff!

Hire more staff, take more days off... Before cutting corners,
there are things I should be doing. Time to get fired up and start fresh!
And now you even have... this massive line... *sniff*...!
...Huh? No.

Early one weekend afternoon.
I stopped by an open-air café to take a breather, and—

I devoured them like nom nom nom,
and had five whole seconds!

No, it's not like that!
That's not what I meant, Boss!!

Thanks to you, I remembered what it felt like back then...
The pure joy of making my favorite crepes with all my heart, and having people relish every single bite.
Boss, the recipe!! ...Did you change the way they taste?

Y-A-A-A-Y!!
Now this is officially the best day off eveeeeeer!!

When my tummy let out a huge rumble, you made me just one last crepe!
And as expected, it was the abso-luuuuute best crepe ever!!

SOOOOO GOOOOOOD!!
Awesome, awesome, this is so freakin' awesomeeee!!

Yep! This crepe shop has been my go-to haunt
ever since I first enrolled at Tracen Academy!

While feeling a bit concerned by how he acted,
I went ahead and took a bite of the crepe—

Then it started getting featured more and more on TV and in magazines,
and in the blink of an eye, he opened up this gorgeous, proper storefront in such a great spot!
Sorry, but I'm really busy right now. We can talk later—

...I'm glad.
Just like back then, I poured everything I had into making it.

When we finally reached the owner, he was silently making crepes with his head down,
seemingly not even noticing his regular, Winning Ticket.

...Yeah.
That was so delicious, Trainer!
Ugh...
A few minutes later, the owner brought out a freshly made crepe for us.

So sorry, folks! The next party will be our final order for today~
...All right, last two guests, what can I get started for ya~?

Soothing Winning Ticket, who couldn't stop crying happy tears,
we waited in the long, long line until we finally reached the front to order.

...Without knowing what was going on, I was dragged along
and ended up at the back of a huge line outside a crepe shop.

Whoaaa, no way! The line got even bigger! And longer!
This... this is just...

Boss! Hey, Boss!!
What's wrong, what's wrong, what happened to you!?

Tr-Trainer-saaaan!?
I can't believe it, running into you in a place like this...!

I remember it, that flavor! There's no way I'd ever forget!!
I don't wanna... forget it, Bossssssshhhhh...!!

Seriously, it was just sooo delicious!
My chest got all fiery hot, it was overwhelming...!
